body.voice_description: Create an original voice for Biscuit, a talking cartoon puppy who coaches chess. The voice of the puppy itself: soft, high, light and airy without whispering, with innocent wide-eyed sincerity and warm curiosity. Gentle delighted reactions, then a calm, simple explanation in clear, natural English words. No barks, whimpers, panting or other animal noises, and never squeaky or theatrical. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional character voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Oh, there it is! That move leaves a piece with no defender. Let's check the reply together, then try to keep that piece protected.
